items.q: Which property describes metals being hammered into a thin sheet?
items.qAf: Watter eienskap beskryf metale wat tot ’n dun plaat gehamer word?
items.explain: Malleability means a material can be hammered or rolled into thin sheets without breaking.
items.explainAf: Smeebaarheid beteken ’n materiaal kan sonder om te breek tot dun plate gehamer of gerol word.

items.q: Non-metals such as sulfur are usually:
items.explain: Most non-metals are brittle when solid and do not conduct electricity well.
items.explainAf: Die meeste nie-metale is bros as vaste stowwe en gelei nie elektrisiteit goed nie.

items.q: Why are metals used for saucepan bases?
items.qAf: Waarom word metale vir pannebodems gebruik?
options: They are soft and break easily
optionsAf: Hulle is sag en breek maklik
items.explain: Metals conduct heat quickly, so the heat from the stove spreads through the pan.
items.explainAf: Metale gelei hitte vinnig, so die hitte van die stoof versprei deur die pan.

items.q: Which material is best for the wire inside an electrical cable?
items.qAf: Watter materiaal is die beste vir die draad binne ’n elektriese kabel?
items.explain: Copper is a good conductor, so electricity flows through it easily.
items.explainAf: Koper is ’n goeie geleier, so elektrisiteit vloei maklik daardeur.

items.q: The outer covering of the same cable is usually plastic. Why?
items.qAf: Die buitenste omhulsel van dieselfde kabel is gewoonlik plastiek. Hoekom?
options: It insulates, so people are not shocked
optionsAf: Dit isoleer, sodat mense nie geskok word nie
items.explain: Plastic is an insulator, which keeps the electricity inside the wire and protects people from shocks.
items.explainAf: Plastiek is ’n isolator, wat die elektrisiteit binne die draad hou en mense teen skokke beskerm.

items.q: Aluminium is used for drink cans. Which property makes it a good choice?
items.qAf: Aluminium word vir drankblikkies gebruik. Watter eienskap maak dit ’n goeie keuse?
options: It is light and resists corrosion
It is a poor conductor of heat
optionsAf: Dit is ligte en weerstaan korrosie
Dit is ’n swak geleier van hitte
items.explain: Aluminium is light, strong for its weight, and does not rust easily, which suits a can.
items.explainAf: Aluminium is lig, sterk vir sy gewig, en roes nie maklik nie, wat by ’n blikkie pas.

items.q: Able to be hammered into thin sheets.
items.qAf: Kan in dun plate geslaan word.

items.q: Able to be drawn out into thin wires.
items.qAf: Kan in dun drade uitgetrek word.

items.q: The only metal that is a liquid at room temperature.
items.qAf: Die enigste metaal wat by kamertemperatuur ’n vloeistof is.

items.q: The non-metal that, as graphite, conducts electricity.
items.qAf: Die niemetaal wat as grafiet elektrisiteit gelei.

items.textAf: Koper word vir elektriese drade gebruik omdat dit rekbaar en ’n goeie [[]] is. Aluminium word vir vliegtuie gebruik omdat dit sterk is en ’n lae [[]] het.

items.q: Most non-metals are brittle when solid.
items.qAf: Die meeste niemetale is bros wanneer hulle vas is.
items.explain: True. Solid non-metals such as sulfur break or crumble when hit; they are not malleable.
items.explainAf: Waar. Vaste niemetale soos swael breek of verkrummel wanneer hulle geslaan word; hulle is nie smeebaar nie.

items.explain: False. Only a few metals, such as iron, nickel and cobalt, are magnetic.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Net ’n paar metale, soos yster, nikkel en kobalt, is magneties.

items.explain: True. They are gases at room temperature and do not conduct electricity.
items.explainAf: Waar. Hulle is gasse by kamertemperatuur en gelei nie elektrisiteit nie.

items.q: Explain why cooking pots are often made of steel but have plastic or wooden handles.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom kookpotte dikwels van staal gemaak word, maar plastiek- of houthandvatsels het.
points: Steel is a metal and a good conductor of heat, so heat passes quickly to the food.
Plastic/wood is a poor conductor (insulator), so the handle stays cool enough to hold.
pointsAf: Staal is ’n metaal en ’n goeie hittegeleier, dus gaan hitte vinnig na die kos oor.
Plastiek/hout is ’n swak geleier (isolator), dus bly die handvatsel koel genoeg om vas te hou.
